newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria lev idles vs mark, falls on dollar.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria lev idles vs mark, falls on dollar.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev idled at 994-995 per mark in light interbank volume at the close on Wednesday, flat from the opening and Tuesday's close amid a summer lull on the local market, traders said.
* Falling mark/dollar on global markets pushed the lev/dollar to 1,874-1,878 at the close from 1,870-1,872 in the morning and 1,868-1,870 at Tuesday's close.
* The lev has been pegged at 1,000 per mark as an anchor in an IMF-prescribed currency board system, a fixed exchange rate regime aimed at restoring confidence in the lev.
* Under the system introduced on July 1 Bulgaria's central bank pledged to buy and sell unlimited volumes of marks at 995 levs bid and 1,000 ask. -- Sofia Newsroom, (++359-2) 91188
